chunks: And Aban narrated from Hariz, from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام:

Regarding a man who borrowed a garment, then deliberately turned to it and pledged it as collateral; then the owners of the property came for their property, so he عليه السلام said: “They take their property.”

key_terms.أَهْلُ الْمَتَاعِ: the rightful owners of the property
key_terms.ثَوْبًا: a garment or piece of clothing

ai.seo_question: If someone borrows an item and then uses it as collateral, can the original owners reclaim it?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about borrowed property that was wrongfully pledged as collateral by the borrower. It establishes that the true owners retain their right to recover their property, affirming the protection of ownership rights in Shia jurisprudence.
